data_scope: NQ and ES clean Databento RTH 1-minute; annual expanding walk-forward, first test year 2016, through 2026-07-14; consumed research history
primary_metric: Within-slot Spearman IC between predicted and realised log-change from the trailing 30-minute realised-vol benchmark, 90% session-block-bootstrap CI, with the expansion side gated separately
result_summary: PASS BOTH MARKETS INCLUDING THE DISCRIMINATING EXPANSION GATE - the core is a timing instrument, but EXP-0012's headline is materially QUALIFIED. Primary within-slot IC(predicted log-change, realised log-change) vs the trailing 30-minute RV benchmark: +0.3766 [+0.3690,+0.3841] NQ and +0.3901 [+0.3819,+0.3984] ES. Expansion-only side, preregistered as the discriminating gate because contraction calls after a spike are nearly free: +0.2201 [+0.2050,+0.2351] NQ and +0.2380 [+0.2240,+0.2520] ES - clears on both, so the pass is not mean-reversion arithmetic. Degenerate control (same statistic using the free same-slot median) +0.2403/+0.2518, so the model's marginal value on this axis is +0.1363/+0.1383. Stable across all 11 years (0.350-0.436) and all 11 slots (0.345-0.421). THE BIGGER RESULT: PERSISTENCE IS A FAR HARDER BENCHMARK THAN SEASONALITY. Within-slot IC vs realised RV is model +0.8808/+0.8740, persistence +0.8674/+0.8610, seasonality +0.4186/+0.3830 - so EXP-0012's ~+0.47 delta over the same-slot median is only +0.013 over trailing 30-min RV. Persistence alone scores log-MSE skill +0.686/+0.710 over seasonality; the model's skill over PERSISTENCE is +0.187/+0.148. EXP-0012 is not wrong, it was measured against a weak benchmark: the LEVELS are nearly all persistence, the DELTAS are where the model lives. Skill rises MONOTONICALLY with disagreement size (decile 1 -> 10: IC +0.033 -> +0.643, skill vs P +0.001 -> +0.426), i.e. most right exactly where it would be used - the opposite of the overconfidence failure mode. HONEST CAVEAT: on expansion calls the RANKING works (+0.22/+0.24) but log-MSE skill over persistence is only +0.008 NQ / +0.061 ES vs +0.300/+0.211 on contractions, so the direction-of-change call transfers and the magnitude call largely does not. Model calls expansion 40.0%/42.2% of the time; mean realised log-change on those calls +0.054/+0.069 (right in sign). This makes backlog item 13 (scheduled calendar) a TARGETED next step with a specific cell to beat. Benchmark is the strict backward twin of the target (tested: past_rv30_bp[p] == fwd_rv_bp[p-31]), coverage 99.98% uniform. Tests 29/29.
